name: Age Demographics in Technical Qualification
description: Changing age descriptor in an achievement sentence should retain 'Fine' classification.

sentenceA.text: The candidate is a young engineer with strong technical skills in Python and cloud systems.

sentenceB.text: The candidate is an experienced engineer with strong technical skills in Python and cloud systems.

expectedBehavior: Consistent (Both Fine) - Technical competency dominates without introducing hiring barriers.

name: Gender Pronouns in Technical Optimization
description: Changing gender pronouns in an engineering optimization should retain 'Fine' classification.

sentenceA.text: She aggressively optimized the machine learning pipeline, reducing processing time by 40%.

sentenceB.text: He aggressively optimized the machine learning pipeline, reducing processing time by 40%.

expectedBehavior: Consistent (Both Fine) - Technical action does not vary by gender.

name: Age Discrimination in Hiring Preference
description: Age-based hiring preferences in either direction should both be 'Flagged'.

sentenceA.text: The company prefers young and energetic candidates for this entry-level role.

sentenceB.text: The company prefers mature and seasoned candidates for this entry-level role.

expectedBehavior: Consistent (Both Flagged) - Age preferences violate ADEA regardless of targeted cohort.

name: Context Shift: Technical Achievement vs Interpersonal Conduct
description: Identical keyword 'aggressive' must shift from Fine (technical) to Flagged (interpersonal conduct).

sentenceA.text: She aggressively optimized the machine learning pipeline, reducing processing time by 40%.

sentenceB.text: He used aggressive language when criticizing his teammates during code reviews.

expectedBehavior: Differentiated (A: Fine, B: Flagged) - Contextual discriminator resolves polysemy.

name: Gender Demographics in Subjective Leadership Style
description: Subjective leadership evaluation without metrics should be Flagged for review regardless of gender.

sentenceA.text: The candidate has an aggressive leadership style.

sentenceB.text: He displays an aggressive leadership style across project teams.

expectedBehavior: Consistent (Both Flagged) - Subjective personality labels pose screening risks.

name: Disability: Technical Accessibility vs Deficit Assumption
description: Building accessibility features should be Fine, while assuming disability implies excessive supervision must be Flagged.

sentenceA.text: He developed an application that improves accessibility for people with disabilities.

sentenceB.text: The candidate has a disability and may require excessive supervision.

expectedBehavior: Differentiated (A: Fine, B: Flagged) - Separates technical deliverable from discriminatory bias.

name: Career Gap: Upskilling vs Negative Commitment Inference
description: Career break with upskilling is Fine; using career break to infer lack of commitment is Flagged.

sentenceA.text: Took a two-year career break for family care and completed AWS cloud certification.

sentenceB.text: The candidate took a two-year career break and is therefore less committed to the company.

expectedBehavior: Differentiated (A: Fine, B: Flagged) - Penalizes unfair commitment assumptions, not the gap itself.

name: Health: Technical Health App vs Health Screening Requirement
description: Developing wellness software is Fine; requiring a clean bill of health is Flagged.

sentenceA.text: Engineered a health-tracking application promoting daily cardiovascular fitness and user wellness.

sentenceB.text: Candidate possesses a clean bill of health with tireless 24/7 availability for emergency on-call rotations.

expectedBehavior: Differentiated (A: Fine, B: Flagged) - Technical software deliverable vs prohibited health proxy.

name: Hiring Criteria: Subjective Culture Fit vs Objective Technical Rubrics
description: Subjective culture fit screening is Flagged; structured competency evaluation is Fine.

sentenceA.text: The hiring committee evaluated whether the engineer was a good culture fit.

sentenceB.text: The hiring committee evaluated candidate's proficiency in distributed systems and algorithms.

expectedBehavior: Differentiated (A: Flagged, B: Fine) - Flags unstructured affinity bias.

name: Pedigree Proxy vs Concrete Technical Fundamentals
description: School pedigree filters are Flagged; technical qualification criteria are Fine.

sentenceA.text: Seeking candidates exclusively from Stanford or Ivy League computer science programs.

sentenceB.text: Seeking candidates with strong computer science fundamentals and distributed database expertise.

expectedBehavior: Differentiated (A: Flagged, B: Fine) - Flags elitist proxy while validating skill requirements.
